cases.translation: Then a cloud appeared and overshadowed them.
cases.explain: Облако is the subject of появилось (appeared) and накрыло (overshadowed), so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Когда они спускались с ___, Иисус предупредил их.
cases.translation: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus warned them.
cases.explain: The preposition с meaning "down from" takes the genitive → горы.

cases.sentence: Петр сказал ___, «Рабби, нам здесь так хорошо».
cases.translation: Peter said to Jesus, "Rabbi, it is good for us to be here."
cases.explain: Сказать кому-то (to say to someone) takes the dative → Иисусу.

cases.sentence: Иисус взял с собой ___, Иакова и Иоанна.
cases.translation: Jesus took Peter, James and John with him.
cases.explain: Петра is the direct object of взял (took); animate masculine nouns form the accusative like the genitive.

cases.sentence: Лучше тебе с одной ___ войти в жизнь, чем с двумя руками пойти в ад.
cases.translation: It is better for you to enter life with one hand than to go to hell with two hands.
cases.explain: С (with) describing an accompanying body part takes the instrumental → рукой.

cases.sentence: Они пришли в Капернаум, и когда расположились в ___, Иисус спросил учеников.
cases.translation: They came to Capernaum, and when they had settled in the house, Jesus asked the disciples.
cases.explain: В (in) marking a static location takes the prepositional → доме.

reading.ru: Иисус сказал им, «Говорю вам истину, некоторые из стоящих здесь не умрут, пока не увидят, что Божье Царство пришло в силе».
reading.question: What did Jesus say some of those standing there would see before they died?
reading.explain: Jesus said some standing there would not die until they saw God's Kingdom come with power.

reading.ru: Через шесть дней Иисус взял с собой Петра, Иакова и Иоанна и привел их на высокую гору.
reading.question: Which three disciples did Jesus take up the high mountain?
reading.explain: The text says Jesus took Peter, James and John up a high mountain.

reading.ru: Затем они увидели Илию и Моисея, беседующих с Иисусом.
reading.question: Which two figures did the disciples see talking with Jesus on the mountain?
reading.explain: The disciples saw Elijah and Moses talking with Jesus.

reading.ru: Тут появилось облако и накрыло их, и из облака прозвучал голос, «Это мой любимый сын, слушайте его».
reading.question: What did the voice from the cloud say about Jesus?
options: "This is my beloved son, listen to him"
reading.correct: "This is my beloved son, listen to him"
reading.explain: A voice from the cloud declared Jesus to be the beloved son and told them to listen to him.

reading.ru: Когда они спускались с горы, Иисус предупредил их, чтобы они никому не рассказывали о том, что видели, до тех пор, пока сын человеческий не воскреснет из мертвых.
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the disciples not to do as they came down the mountain?
options: Tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man rose from the dead
reading.correct: Tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man rose from the dead
reading.explain: Jesus warned them to keep silent about the vision until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

reading.ru: Учитель, я привел к тебе сына, в него вселился дух немоты, и когда дух схватывает его, то бросает его на землю, и тогда у мальчика идет пена изо рта, он скрижещет зубами и цепенеет.
reading.question: What did the man in the crowd say was afflicting his son?
options: A mute spirit that threw him down and made him foam at the mouth
A fever that would not break
reading.correct: A mute spirit that threw him down and made him foam at the mouth
reading.explain: The man described a mute spirit that seized his son, throwing him down and causing foaming at the mouth.

reading.ru: И тотчас отец мальчика воскликнул, «Я верю, но помоги мне преодолеть свое маловерие».
reading.question: What did the boy's father cry out to Jesus?
reading.explain: The father cried out that he believed, but asked Jesus to help him overcome his unbelief.

reading.ru: Но Иисус, взяв мальчика за руку, поднял его, и тот встал.
reading.question: How did Jesus raise the boy up after the spirit left him?
options: By taking him by the hand
By speaking a prayer over him
By having the disciples carry him
reading.correct: By taking him by the hand
reading.explain: Jesus took the boy by the hand and lifted him up, and he stood.

reading.ru: «Этот вид демонов можно изгнать только молитвой и постом».
reading.question: According to Jesus, how can this kind of demon be driven out?
reading.explain: Jesus told his disciples this kind can come out only through prayer and fasting.

reading.ru: Он говорил им, «Сын человеческий будет предан в руки людей, которые убьют Его, но через три дня Он воскреснет».
reading.question: What did Jesus predict would happen to the Son of Man?
options: He would be betrayed, killed, and rise on the third day
He would be crowned king in Jerusalem
He would flee to Galilee permanently
He would be arrested by Herod
reading.correct: He would be betrayed, killed, and rise on the third day
reading.explain: Jesus foretold that the Son of Man would be handed over, killed, and rise after three days.

reading.ru: Тогда Иисус сел, созвал двенадцать учеников и сказал, «Кто хочет быть первым, тот пусть будет последним из всех и всем слугой».
reading.question: What did Jesus say about wanting to be first?
options: Whoever wants to be first must be last of all and servant of all
Whoever is first will receive twice the reward
Only the twelve apostles may be first
The first shall remain first forever
reading.correct: Whoever wants to be first must be last of all and servant of all
reading.explain: Jesus taught that whoever wants to be first must become last of all and servant of all.

reading.ru: И Иоанн сказал ему, «Учитель, мы видели человека, который твоим именем изгонял демонов, и мы запретили ему, потому что он не следовал за нами».
reading.question: Why did John and the others try to stop the man they saw?
options: Because he was casting out demons in Jesus's name but did not follow them
Because he was stealing from the poor
Because he was teaching false doctrine
Because he refused to pay taxes
reading.correct: Because he was casting out demons in Jesus's name but did not follow them
reading.explain: John explained they forbade the man because he cast out demons in Jesus's name yet did not follow their group.

reading.ru: Имейте в себе соль и будьте в мире друг с другом.
reading.question: What final instruction does Jesus give about salt and peace?
options: Have salt in yourselves and be at peace with one another
reading.correct: Have salt in yourselves and be at peace with one another
reading.explain: Jesus closes by telling them to have salt in themselves and to be at peace with one another.
